purpose: English writing and usage guidance: the original rewriting curriculum plus focused grammar, sentence structure and everyday word-choice notes.
selection: Preserve the original 31 curriculum notes and add 169 distinct freeform concepts. New notes have no invented links to canonical drills. Specialist advice remains excluded.
origin: Original curriculum plus independently authored, source-linked expansion. AI-assisted source checks; independent human review pending.
source_policy: Reference URLs support named principles only. No full external lessons or scraped exercise collections are redistributed.
example_policy: Three original positive examples and one counterexample per concept; optional exact canonical drill adaptation.
evaluation_policy: Original evaluation artifacts remain unchanged and describe their recorded corpus. expansion-v3.json supplies authored development coverage for new notes, not held-out evidence. Live evaluation of the 200-note corpus is pending.
exclusions: claims of CEFR certification or measured learning gains
